notes.title: WELCOME!
notes.content:
[h2][b]🧱 Welcome Renovators 🧱[/b][/h2]

[h3]We are delighted to welcome you to our gaming community❗[/h3]

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940270/Bunker_Renovator/]Bunker Renovator[/url][/b] is our new project that will allow you to become the best bunker entrepreneur in the world.

Have you ever dreamed of buying a bunker and turning it into a party room or arcade?  💃  Or maybe just renovate it and sell it to a billionaire who wants a place where he could survive the doomsday?  💥  All this can be done in our game  😎

[url=https://discord.gg/3MDM2G4PM2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42193190/8a1f75a32ac176a064db8e581944f212a64da806.png[/img][/url]

🤝  [b]We put a lot of work to meet your expectations[/b].  🤝

We have done a lot of research and will gradually show you more of what we have planned for you.  Once a month we will publish a devlog with the current state of the game, new gameplay mechanics and more   🥳

We also kindly invite you to join our community on Steam as well as on Discord‼️ 👇
[url=https://discord.gg/3MDM2G4PM2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42193190/f6606ef86362d4c3188439d9b23bef12e3c2b56c.png[/img][/url]


See you in the bunker!
